prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Make one realistic die-cut clear acrylic keychain of the exact chibi Vivhite in the attached image, maintaining her original colors, costume, round gold glasses, white beret and blue butterfly, pale silver blue bob, pink-purple ribbons. The entire figure is flat printed anime art with white ink behind it, surrounded by a narrow transparent 3mm acrylic edge. One physical hole at the top links to a short small metal chain and round ring. Three-quarter front view clearly showing thin acrylic edge, whole ring and chain visible. One object only, isolated on true transparent background, no person, no text, no packaging, no additional ornaments. It must be a printed acrylic charm, never a living girl or 3D figurine.
